versions.content: Continous trigger conditions for freeze frames If the Dem- FreezeFrameRecordTrigger is set to DEM_TRIGGER_ON_EVERY_TEST_FAILED , each time an event was reported as FAILED or after optional debouncing a qualified FAILED is detected the Dem shall capture the Freeze frame .
